messages:
Ayesha Patel: Morning all! Quick poll — who's up for a lunchtime hangboard session on Wed? Climb gym nearby reserved 12:30–1:15. Low-key bouldering + fingerboard. Reply with ✅ or 🚫. Also, any lead-rope practice folks?
Ben Morales: ✅ count me in. I can bring extra tape and chalk.
Maya Lin: 🚫 dentist appt 😩 — next week for me.
Sam O'Neill: Maybe — I have intervals at 12. If I skip, can I crash the hangboard afterwards? 😅 
Claire Zhao: If anyone's doing a warmup run afterward, I'm in for 3–4 miles.
Jules Ramirez: I'll be there — bringing a foam roller and maybe some hangboard tips for folks trying it first time. Also, how's everyone doing on the step challenge? Halfway to 10k today 🙌
strava-bot: Ben Morales uploaded an activity: "Lunchtime 5k tempo" https://strava.example/activities/12345
Ayesha Patel: Nice — so far: Ben, Jules, Claire, Sam (maybe). Maya out. I'll book the pad at 12:25 to avoid overlap.
Ben Morales: Heads-up — bring a thin glove if your skin is raw. Also one extra pair of climbing shoes in locker 4 if anyone needs.
Sam O'Neill: If someone wants to do 4x400m near the building at 12 I can join after intervals. Might pair nicely with a cooldown jog.
Ayesha Patel: I have one extra pair of shoes (men's 41 EU) and a small crash pad. If anyone needs gear, speak now.
Jules Ramirez: Can I borrow the shoes? size 41 EU works for me.
Ayesha Patel: Yep, I'll leave them in locker 3 with a sticky note.
Claire Zhao: 👍 perfect. See you wed 12:30. If it pours, backup plan is an in-office mobility + core session in conf C.
Ben Morales: Also quick PSA — tape and disinfectant at the gym are limited, so bring your own if you can.
Maya Lin: Boo dentist, but excited to see photos/gifs. Have fun y'all! 👏
